title: Germany: the Flat Foot Stompers and good money
summary: He plays with the Flat Foot Stompers and the Barrelhouse Jazz Band and records with them; Germany pays the most and answers quickly.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: -- I've been with many, many bands in Germany. The last time I was in Germany, I played near Stuttgart-- and to show you the interest now about what's happening, in a place like Germany - Germany is one of the best buying countries of jazz in the world right today - they've got the money - believe me, they've got the money to do it. I played with their Flat Foot Stompers and getting back to the Flat Foot, I've played with another band over there called the Barrelhouse Jazz Band and they were unbelievable - oh, they played everything - from Ellington arrangements to Dixieland and swing and what not they did, and I recorded with them for the--- for a place called The America House, which was in Dusseldorf-- and I did just a slight tour with these guys and they're wonderful. But, getting back to the Flat Foot Stompers, I just made a record with them; Peanuts was there ahead of me and he made half the record and I joined the same band and did about ten days with these guys and I recorded the other half; so the record has just been released.
We just got it in the mail the other day.

Yeah - and I was just going to say - when you talk to someone through Germany or my wife talks to someone that wants me to come and you talk money, Ann always seems to get more money out of Germany than any other place I've worked because there's never any silence at the other end -- where they say - well, maybe -- or anything - they say - okay - fine. Then, of course, well, you know what's happening in England with me --
